selection: inner LOSO: unknown rejection >= C0, known acceptance loss <= 1 percentage point, stable AUC/F1 trend, worst identity not worse; maximize known acceptance

temporal_split.inner_calibration: held identity unknown and remaining identities known, 0.4 < frac <= 0.6
temporal_split.evaluation: outer held identity and known identities, frac > 0.8

identity_decision: top-1 strict LDA-cos; refusal score never changes ranking
threshold: identity-balanced weighted FAR10 from inner pseudo-unknown scores
